title: feat(spec): CloneFlowResponseSchema declares an optional data.noticeCode beside notice
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8JbeVEbdsiqjx3ASFPM7H2E)_

Fixes #29758

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

This is the contract-first half of #29727 and unblocks it: the server half (sending the code from the flow clone door) stays on #29727.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:流程「新建相似」(clone) 接口的响应 schema 在 `notice` 旁新增可选字段 `noticeCode`,用一个稳定代码标识这句提示。
- 为什么改:`notice` 是服务端写死的英文句子,控制台无从得知是哪一句,中文界面只能原样显示英文;有了代码,控制台可以换成自己的译文。
- 风险与回滚:仅为可选键,旧服务端不发它时照常解析,`notice` 仍必填、仍是英文兜底;回滚即撤掉该键,无数据迁移。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/api/automation-api.zod.ts`(`CloneFlowResponseSchema` 的 `noticeCode` 与其说明),`packages/spec/src/api/automation-api.zod.test.ts`(四条 pin),`.changeset/29758-clone-flow-notice-code.md`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/api/automation-api.zod.test.ts`,预期 72/72 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(键名 `noticeCode` 在否决窗口内,有异议请在本 PR 说)。

## What changes

- `CloneFlowResponseSchema.data` (`packages/spec/src/api/automation-api.zod.ts`) declares `noticeCode: z.string().optional()` beside `notice`, described as a stable code naming the `notice` sentence: a client maps a code it knows to its own translated sentence and falls back to `notice` verbatim for an unknown or absent code. No code values are enumerated; the vocabulary is the server's (#29727). `notice` and its describe are unchanged. The schema's TSDoc gains one sentence saying the same.
- Name: `noticeCode`, the seat's call under the veto window. A key named `THING` + `Code` for the code of a sibling sentence follows `declaredCode` in `packages/spec/src/api/contract.zod.ts`.
- Generated: `content/docs/references/api/automation-api.mdx` (via `gen:docs`) is the only artefact the member moves. `check:authorable-surface`, `check:api-surface`, `check:export-origins`, `check:declaration-map` and `check:strictness-ledger` stayed green with no regeneration: the authorable-surface shard lists `api/CloneFlowResponse:data` and nothing below it, and no export was added.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/spec` **patch**, not the minor the dispatch named. `Metadata-protocol: none` (a REST answer shape is nothing a metadata author writes, and no authorable-surface shard moved), and `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` refuses a `minor` beside `none`; a non-protocol widening ships `patch` and keeps `Clause-②: yes (widening)`. `@objectstack/client` gets no entry: `automation.clone()` returns `CloneFlowResponse['data']` imported from `@objectstack/spec` (a dependency, external to the client's tsup build), so its emitted types do not change.

## Why

The Console prints `data.notice` verbatim, so the flow "New similar" notice shows English under zh-CN (#29706 row 1). Nothing in the answer named which sentence it was. A code beside it lets the Console translate it, contract-first, before the server sends one.

## Tests

`packages/spec/src/api/automation-api.zod.test.ts`, new `describe('CloneFlowResponseSchema — data.noticeCode names the notice sentence')`:

1. accepts a string `noticeCode` beside `notice` and keeps it on the parsed value;
2. an answer without `noticeCode` still parses;
3. `notice` is still required (one issue, `invalid_type` at `data.notice`);
4. a non-string `noticeCode` is refused (one issue, `invalid_type` at `data.noticeCode`).

Ablation, once, on the committed head `d419dc32` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (the test imports `./automation-api.zod` from source, so no dist leg): renaming the key to `noticeCodeAblated` landed on disk (anchor 1 → 0, blob `767587bb7ef0` → `c06b7927ece5`); pins 1 and 4 went red (2 failed, 70 passed); restored to blob `767587bb7ef0` with `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

Consumers of `CloneFlowResponse`, read on `origin/main` `c9c68288`:

- `packages/client/src/index.ts` `automation.clone()` returns `CloneFlowResponse['data']`: gains the optional key through the type, no edit.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` (the clone handler) answers `{ flow, packageId, notice: FLOW_CLONE_NOTICE }` from `packages/runtime/src/flow-clone.ts`: unchanged here, and still parses (the key is optional). Serving the code is #29727.
- `packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts` names `CloneFlowResponseSchema` for the clone row; its note spells `data` as `{ flow, packageId, notice }`, which #29727 updates when it serves the code.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-flow-clone-custom-package.test.ts` parses each answer through the schema: still green by construction (optional key).
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/AutomationsPillar.newSimilar-28567.test.tsx` names the schema in a comment only. The Console mapping is #29706.

`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` is not touched (freeze).
